changelog: [When to Segment]: added five new permissive, generalizable cues directly targeting the critic's measured free-latency under-segmentation cases — (1) a standalone sentence-initial discourse adverb (e.g. '어쨌든','아무튼','일단','사실') before a main clause, split right after it; (2) a statement followed by a rhetorical tag-question (e.g. '...거 알지?','...잖아?') that merely checks agreement, split right before the tag question; (3) chains of two or more sequential time/action clauses joined by '-고 나서'/'나중에'/'끝나고' where each clause already has its own resolved subject/verb, split after each connective; (4) a topic-establishing setup clause followed by a distinct concluding/resultative statement marked off by a discourse marker like '이제' or '그래서', split right before the conclusion; (5) explicitly extended the existing '?' rule to cover enumerated self-questioned alternatives ending in '?' before an unrelated concluding clause. These add concrete permissive rules without introducing new restrictions, per the 'segment more aggressively' direction.

[Never Segment]: narrowed the blanket '이제-is-always-filler' prohibition with an explicit, generalizable exception — splitting immediately before '이제' is allowed when it marks the transition from a completed topic-establishing/setup clause to a distinct concluding statement (per the new [When to Segment] rule), rather than banning any cut near '이제' outright.
